label: emotion
definition: A strong affective response to an event or situation, with a characteristic subjective experience.

label: feeling
definition: the experiencing of affective and emotional states
uncertainty_note: Affective sense. The word-level haptic rating can include the touch sense.

label: mood
definition: a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling

label: fear
definition: an emotion arising in anticipation of danger or pain

label: anger
definition: a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance

label: disgust
definition: strong feelings of dislike

label: joy
definition: the emotion of great happiness

label: sadness
definition: emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being

label: panic
definition: an overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety

label: nausea
definition: the state that precedes vomiting

label: rage
definition: a feeling of intense anger

label: anxiety
definition: a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune

label: resentment
definition: a feeling of deep and bitter anger and ill-will

label: nostalgia
definition: longing for something past

label: warmth
definition: the sensation caused by heat energy
uncertainty_note: Thermal sense. Word ratings may also reflect interpersonal affection.

label: heaviness
definition: the property of being comparatively great in weight

label: freeze
definition: an interruption or temporary suspension of progress or movement
uncertainty_note: General interruption sense. The word norm may also evoke cold.

label: flood
definition: the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land

label: sting
definition: a sudden sharp pain resembling the sensation of an insect bite

label: scar
definition: a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue

label: entity
definition: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

label: abstraction
definition: a general concept formed by extracting common features from specific examples

label: attribute
definition: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity

label: psychological feature
definition: a feature of the mental life of a living organism

label: symptom
definition: (medicine) any sensation or change in bodily function that is experienced by a patient and is associated with a particular disease
